(formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGK&quot;) of outstanding common stock of MSGR to MSGK stockholders, effected on October 26, 2026 (the &quot;Distribution&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3. In the Distribution, MSGK distributed one share of MSGR's Class A common stock (&quot;Class A Common Stock&quot;) and one share of MSGR's Class B common stock to MSGK stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively, in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9. Each RSU is granted under the MSGR 2026 Employee Stock Plan and represents a right to receive one share of MSGR Class A Common Stock or the cash equivalent thereof.</footnote>
